STRATEGY: Parent cooperates, retaliates against repeated defections, forgives single defections, and defects on the last round if opponent cooperated. The trace simulates the parent and other population slots against a single early defection probe, then designs a revised strategy that adds an early probe when the opponent has never defected, occasional exploitation of highly cooperative opponents, and endgame defection.

STRATEGY: The parent cooperates initially, probes/defects occasionally, punishes single defections once then forgives, and exploits near the end. The trace simulates variants against forgiving opponents (slot 2, slot 5, slot 6) and retaliating opponents, tracing round-by-round scores. It changes the strategy by adding a probe at n=5, a forgiveness detector, and a defection schedule (e.g., every 10th round when defections < n//10) to exploit forgiving opponents while avoiding retaliation.

The trace simulates it against slots 0,1,2,3,5,6 and adds a one-time probe defection at n>=10, then occasional defections when forgiveness is high. It changes the last-round defect to n==99 and keeps the rest of parent's logic.
